rows.commentary: 0.1: Smit drops it full on off, swinging in sharply to catch Tim Tector's inside edge onto the pads for a dot.
0.2: Smit maintains the full length on off, angling it across as Tim Tector pushes forward to block toward the off-side.
0.3: Smit finds extra zip off a good length in the channel, whistling past Tim Tector's outside edge as he plays back.
0.4: Smit hits a back of a length and slants it across, allowing Tim Tector to stay back and comfortably defend.
0.5: Smit extracts sharp lift off the surface once more, drawing Tim Tector into a stroke that misses the outside edge entirely.
0.6: Smit digs it back of a length and angles it away, permitting Tim Tector to steer it toward point and get off the mark.
1.1: Ruben Trumpelmann bowls a wide to Tim Tector.
1.1: Dot ball from Ruben Trumpelmann to Tim Tector.
13.6: Harry Tector steps down the pitch again, but Max Heingo sprays it completely down the leg side for a wide.
13.6: Max Heingo angles a length ball back into Harry Tector, who solidly gets behind it to defend toward point.
14.1: Jack Brassell asks the right questions in the channel, tempting Cade Carmichael into a booming drive away from the body that beats the edge entirely.
14.2: Jack Brassell digs it back of a length outside off, prompting Cade Carmichael to dead-bat it into the off-side.
14.3: Cade Carmichael throws the kitchen sink at a shorter, wide delivery from Jack Brassell, forcefully punching it out toward the covers.
14.4: Jack Brassell drops one right in the slot, and Cade Carmichael drills a firm drive straight to mid-off without finding the gap.
14.5: Jack Brassell hits the spot with a length delivery angling in, forcing Cade Carmichael to play a straight defensive stroke off the front foot.
14.6: Jack Brassell pitches slightly shorter and outside off, letting Cade Carmichael guide it down to third man for a single.
15.1: Max Heingo drops it short and wide outside off, allowing Cade Carmichael to stand tall and punch two comfortable runs away to deep point.
15.2: Max Heingo misses the yorker and serves a juicy half-volley, which Cade Carmichael marches down the track to drill all along the ground to long-on for a much-needed boundary.
15.3: Cade Carmichael dances down the track to another shortish delivery from Max Heingo but fails to connect with the cut shot.
15.4: Max Heingo drops it short outside off, allowing Cade Carmichael to play it late and dab it down to third man for a single.
15.5: Max Heingo hones in on the off-stump channel as Harry Tector retreats to steer a single toward third man.
15.6: Max Heingo drops it back of a length outside off, allowing Cade Carmichael to rise and force a single square on the off-side.
16.1: Jack Brassell cuts one back sharply into the pads of Cade Carmichael, who defends unsuccessfully as an optimistic appeal sails harmlessly over the stumps.
16.2: Jack Brassell offers width on a short delivery, and Cade Carmichael matches the bounce to carve a brace through deep backward point.
16.3: Jack Brassell angles it in from outside off, forcing Cade Carmichael directly behind the line to absorb the defensive block.
16.4: Jack Brassell pitches full in the hitting arc, prompting Cade Carmichael to loft an aerial drive toward mid-off.
16.5: Jack Brassell tails one in from outside off, with Cade Carmichael stepping down the pitch to clip a single toward mid-wicket.
16.6: Jack Brassell unleashes a vicious lifter outside off that leaves Harry Tector grasping at thin air.
26.2: Trumpelmann targets the back of a length, and Neill's fierce pull shot finds only empty space beneath the willow.
26.3: Trumpelmann induces a wild charge and a thick outside edge, but Brassels commits a shocking fumble at third man to gift Neill a reprieve.
26.4: Trumpelmann serves a probing good-length delivery outside off, steered smoothly wide of mid-on for a brisk single by Neill.
26.5: Trumpelmann bangs it in short, prompting Hoey to leap and ramp it toward third man where Brassels dives brilliantly to save the boundary.
26.6: Trumpelmann attacks the channel around off stump, catching the toe-end of Hoey's defensive push into the off-side.
27.1: Myburgh slides one in with the arm to strike Neill on the pad, but the umpire correctly judges it to be missing leg.
27.2: Myburgh tosses it up on off stump, inviting Neill forward to clip it neatly past the mid-wicket fielder.
27.3: Myburgh flights one invitingly close to off, and Hoey meets it solidly in defense.
27.4: Myburgh drags his length back as Hoey swings across the line and misses, surviving another stifling leg-before appeal.
27.5: Myburgh teases it up around off stump, leaving Hoey grasping at thin air past the outside edge.
27.6: Myburgh floats the delivery up on off, met assuredly by Hoey behind a straight bat.
28.1: Trumpelmann pitches on a good length outside off, and Neill pushes it firmly in the direction of the cover fielder.
28.2: Ruben Trumpelmann drops it short, and Jordan Neill masters the bounce to drill a pull away for four toward deep mid-wicket.
28.3: A single to Jordan Neill off Ruben Trumpelmann.
28.4: Ruben Trumpelmann slides one fuller outside off, allowing Gavin Hoey to stroke a single out to sweeper cover.
28.5: Ruben Trumpelmann alters his angle with a full delivery, but Jordan Neill shuffles across to whip it off his pads all the way for six past deep mid-wicket.
28.6: Ruben Trumpelmann tries the short length again, only for Jordan Neill to stand tall and disdainfully smoke a pull through the vacant mid-wicket area for four.
29.1: Willem Myburgh tosses it up near off stump, prompting Gavin Hoey to push off the outer half toward backward point for nothing.
29.2: Willem Myburgh strays down leg, where Gavin Hoey kneels to sweep toward short fine leg, exploiting a misfield as the defender dives straight over the ball for four.
0.1: Jai Moondra starts on a length outside off, steered cleanly towards point by Michael van Lingen.
0.2: Moondra pitches it up outside off, nibbling away as Michael van Lingen watches it pass with arms shouldered.
0.3: Moondra targets a fuller length around middle and leg, flicked away toward wide mid-on by Michael van Lingen for a single.
0.4: Moondra attacks the channel outside off with good carry on a length, left strictly alone by Louren Steenkamp.
0.5: Louren Steenkamp opens his account instantly, leaning into a full and wide delivery from Moondra to drive it through cover-point for four.
0.6: Moondra angles one away outside off, prompting Louren Steenkamp to offer a watchful shoulder.
1.1: Jordan Neill drops slightly short on middle and leg, clipped away toward square leg by Michael van Lingen for one.
1.2: Neill operates from the back of a length around middle and leg, dead-batted toward mid-wicket with soft hands by Louren Steenkamp.
1.3: Neill delivers on a length around middle and leg, nudged solidly in front of mid-on by Louren Steenkamp.
1.4: Neill gets a touch of away movement from a shortish length outside off, handled firmly from a tall stance by Louren Steenkamp.
1.5: Neill fires one straight at the stumps on a length, defended securely from within the crease by Louren Steenkamp.
1.6: Neill tests a length delivery that Louren Steenkamp punches on the rise, only to pick out the fielder stationed at cover-point.
2.1: Jai Moondra drops it on a length around off, and Michael van Lingen punches it firmly on the up straight to mid-off.
2.2: Jai Moondra fires it short and quick outside off, beating Michael van Lingen completely for pace and bounce as he offers a defensive push.
2.3: Jai Moondra pitches it up around middle and leg, allowing Michael van Lingen to flick it away toward mid-wicket for a single.
2.4: Jai Moondra offers width outside off, and Louren Steenkamp leans into a crisp, uppish drive over cover-point that races away to the fence.
2.5: Jai Moondra drifts onto the pads, and Louren Steenkamp works it through backward square leg to comfortably collect a couple of runs.
2.6: Jai Moondra serves it up again, and Louren Steenkamp drives it uppishly toward the cover fielder to end the over.
12.6: Gavin Hoey floats it up invitingly around off stump, and Malan Kruger drives it firmly straight back to the bowler.
13.1: Matthew Humphreys drops it on a length, allowing Gerhard Erasmus to work it into the cover region for a comfortable single.

13.2: Matthew Humphreys sprays this one down the leg-side as Malan Kruger watches it go, while the gloveman flashes the bails off in a split-second only to find the back foot safely anchored within the crease.
13.2: Matthew Humphreys draws a false stroke as Malan Kruger chips it toward cover, where Tector launches to his right and gets a hand to it before it spills out for a single.
13.3: Matthew Humphreys gets attacked as Gerhard Erasmus creates room and drills the ball out toward wide mid-off to collect a run.
13.4: Matthew Humphreys tosses it up, and Malan Kruger simply pushes it along the carpet toward the long-on fielder.
13.5: Matthew Humphreys keeps it tight, forcing Malan Kruger forward to push the delivery securely into the mid-wicket sector.
13.6: Matthew Humphreys feeds the batter short, and Malan Kruger steers it neatly into the pocket at cover to rotate the strike.
14.1: Gavin Hoey unleashes a brilliant googly that snaps past Malan Kruger's defensive prod, nearly grazing the inside edge.
14.2: Gavin Hoey attacks the stumps on a length, and Malan Kruger clips it smoothly away on the leg side to pinch a single.
14.3: Gavin Hoey pitches this one generously up to the batter, permitting Gerhard Erasmus to drive it flat along the ground to long-off.
14.4: Gavin Hoey delivers a full length that Malan Kruger gently knocks down to long-off to complete an easy run.
14.5: Gavin Hoey flights one in on middle and leg, pushed quietly into the mid-wicket region by Gerhard Erasmus before a wayward throw gifts them a second run.
14.6: Gavin Hoey slides one in low past the flick of Gerhard Erasmus, trapping him on the pad as the booming leg-before appeal dies down with the ball tracking past leg.
15.1: Matthew Humphreys loops this one up around off stump, patted straight back down the pitch by Malan Kruger.
15.2: Matthew Humphreys tosses it up further, nudged softly towards the cover fielder by Malan Kruger with a gentle stride forward.
15.3: Matthew Humphreys attacks the length around off, firmly tapped into the off side in front of cover by Malan Kruger.
15.4: Matthew Humphreys pushes it through, deliberately opening the face to steer it down towards third man for a brisk couple.
15.5: Matthew Humphreys drops it slightly shorter, neatly worked around toward fine leg as Malan Kruger scampers back for another two.
15.6: Matthew Humphreys finishes the over as Malan Kruger pats it out toward backward point and steals a sharp single.
16.1: A single to Kruger off Hoey.
16.2: Gavin Hoey tosses one up on middle and leg and gets punished as Gerhard Erasmus dispatches it away to the boundary.
19.2: Matthew Humphreys drops it short into the turning pitch, allowing Zane Green to shift his weight backward and force the pull toward deep backward square for a single.
19.3: Matthew Humphreys tosses this one up on the off stump, and Willem Myburgh strides forward with a straight bat to block it solidly.
19.4: Matthew Humphreys gives this delivery flight around off, and Willem Myburgh guides it softly toward cover-point.

19.5: Matthew Humphreys darts one down the leg side past the glancing bat of Willem Myburgh, whose feet remain anchored while Lorcan Tucker whips off the bails in a flash, though the umpire keeps his arms down.
19.6: Matthew Humphreys drifts the ball into the pads, leaving Willem Myburgh to tuck it square and scamper through to keep the strike.
20.1: Gavin Hoey serves up a delivery slightly too full in length, inviting Willem Myburgh to push it firmly straight to the cover fielder.
20.2: Gavin Hoey floats it up around off, and Willem Myburgh drills a sharp drive straight into the shin of the silly point fielder.
20.3: Gavin Hoey tosses it nicely on off, prompting Willem Myburgh to retreat onto the back foot and defend back down the pitch.
20.4: Gavin Hoey extracts turn from a shorter length, catching Willem Myburgh as he cracks it straight to cover-point.
20.5: Gavin Hoey flights the ball close to off stump, and Willem Myburgh prods forward to dead-bat it toward backward point.
20.6: Gavin Hoey smartly pulls back his length to complete a maiden over as Willem Myburgh gently pats it into the off-side.
21.1: Matthew Humphreys extracts a low bounce from the surface, catching the toe-end of Zane Green's bat as he attempts a cut towards cover.

21.2: Matthew Humphreys offers extra flight, and Zane Green crouches low to deposit the slog sweep over deep mid-wicket for six, sealing a historic five-wicket victory and a maiden series triumph against a full member nation for Namibia.
